dct_description_sm: The aim of this project was to gather information on present and past positions of the spruce timberline in relation to climate change and other environmental factors (aspect, slope, elevation, soil pH, presence/absence of permafrost), reproductive traits and plant associations affecting the trees.  A related purpose was to discover if the changing timberline position is perceived by Yukon users as a factor of importance to their future.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Hunting
Health sciences and contaminants -> Past climate reconstruction
dct_title_s: PPS Arctic Canada: Timberline-related data, Mt. Nansen area, Yukon Plateau
